title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers could import a…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permissions to view and edit containers can import a container archive that causes artifacts to appear linked to cases or notes incorrectly. This occurs because the import process accepts artifact workflow state from the archive rather than deriving it from actual case associations and notes. This discrepancy can lead REST API clients and filters to use inaccurate artifact states.
